title: Manilal v. State of Rajasthan & Ors.
summary: Rajasthan mein Teacher Grade-III (TSP area, 2017 ka vigyapan). Appellant ke graduation mein 44.58% the aur usne B.Ed. mein 23.10.2009 ko pravesh liya tha. 45% se kam hone par uski umeedwari radd hui. Single Judge (27.11.2018) aur Division Bench (27.04.2022) ne use raahat nahi di. Beech mein NCTE ki 13.11.2019 ki notification aayi, aur interim order (23.10.2021) se use niyukti mili, jo High Court ke faisle ke baad 07.06.2022 ko radd kar di gayi.
held: Bilkul waisa hi ek aur umeedwar, Rakesh Gaur (jisne appellant ke baad, 05.11.2009 ko pravesh liya tha), raahat pa chuka tha. 2009-10 session ke ek jaise chhatron mein bhed karna galat hai: "What is sauce for the goose should be sauce for the gander too" (para 15). Appeal allowed. Interim niyukti ko regular maana gaya, wapas seva mein lene aur consequential benefits ka aadesh hua. Back wages sirf kaam kiye samay ki milengi, par pay fitment milega (para 16).
use: Para 8: NCTE ki 13.11.2019 ki proviso shabdon mein, ki 29.07.2011 se pehle B.Ed. pravesh walon par graduation % lagu nahi, aur yeh 29.07.2011 se hi lagu maani gayi.
Para 9–10: yeh notification Neeraj Kumar Rai (2017) ke baad aayi. Para 10 mein Uttarakhand HC ke Baldev Singh (WP 772(SS)/2011) faisle ka bhi zikr hai.
Para 4 (vigyapan ka clause 6.3(1)): jinhone 27.09.2007 se pehle teacher training mein pravesh liya, unke liye graduation % ki koi shart nahi thi. Sateshwari ka B.Ed. 1999 ka hai.
Para 16: seva samaapti ke baad raahat ka tareeka, yaani reinstatement, regular niyukti aur consequential benefits.
caution: Court ne "on the special facts of this case" kaha (para 15). Faisla mukhya roop se barabari (Rakesh Gaur, Ankul Singhal) par tika hai. State keh sakti hai ki yeh notification par aam faisla nahi hai.
Yeh Rajasthan ke vigyapan aur niyamon par hai. Uttarakhand ke niyam aur vigyapan alag se dekhne honge.
bench: B.R. Gavai aur K.V. Viswanathan, JJ. (faisla: K.V. Viswanathan, J.)
